name: CalendarLeafEventCard
job: An event card whose date is a wall-calendar leaf; a tap tears the leaf and turns it into an add-to-calendar download, so visitors save the event instead of forgetting it
visitor_action: tap the leaf or press Enter to add the event to the calendar; the card itself links to details
owner_settings: Start and end date and time
mobile: pad stacks above the details at full width with the duotone photo glowing behind it; from 760px the pad becomes a full-bleed typographic poster field with the info in a band beneath; the leaf curls once when first seen since touch has no hover
motion: pad swings in on its binding and settles, duotone photo drifts into place, the leaf corner curls once as a hint; Add to calendar: corner curls up, the leaf rips along the perforation right-to-left leaving a torn stub, then falls carrying a jagged torn top edge, with gravity, spin, flutter and an oscillating corner curl (bend physics) while the pad springs back and the check draws in on the sheet beneath (reduced-motion: no entrance or curl; leaf fades to the 'Added' sheet)
art_direction: Poster night: dark ink ground, oversized bone date numerals on a dark tear-off leaf as a typographic poster, one vermilion accent (binding, month, CTA), event photo as an ink-to-vermilion duotone glow, condensed heavy grotesk numerals
